note.en: Use analytic Jv, a two-residual central difference, or one-direction forward AD. Apply a Poisson Thomas right preconditioner with two-pass reorthogonalized GMRES/Givens. Start eta=.3, then clamp .9*(Fk/Fk-1)^1.5 to [.001,.5]. This is an explicit EW Choice2-style variant, not the paper’s full safeguards or PETSc defaults.

name.ja: 解析・中央差分・方向ADによるJacobian不要Newton–Krylov
name.en: Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov with analytic, central-FD and directional-AD products

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee.

name.ja: 非滑らかな離散写像：一方向微分と実行trace
name.en: Nonsmooth discrete maps: directional derivatives and executed traces

note.ja: 解析解 abs・ReLU・clip・多項式分岐の固定7点と方向±1を用います。停止反復はx0=0、更新前に|xk−θ|≤1/8を検査し最大5更新。θ=1/4,1/2,1は切替点です。 選択した分岐の微分は普遍的なsubgradientや非滑らかな写像の線形微分ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Use seven fixed points and directions ±1 for abs, ReLU, clip and a polynomial branch. The stopped iteration starts at x0 = 0, tests |xk - theta| <= 1/8 before updating and allows at mostfive updates. Theta 1/4, 1/2 and 1 are switching points. An executed-branch derivative is not a universal subgradient or a linear derivative of a nonsmooth map.
